name: Bonsai
tagline: Bonsai handles the business side of freelancing, including proposals, contracts, time tracking, and invoicing, in one place, with AI-drafted contract clauses and automated payment reminders. Freelancers use it to look more established to clients without hiring an accountant or lawyer for every project.
